items.title: Multicurrency on Mews Terminals (US, Canada, Adyen Europe)
items.summary: Multicurrency by Mews Payments is coming to Mews Terminals: selected US and Canadian properties plus all Adyen-powered terminals in Europe. Guests see rate and fee up front and can pay in their home currency; the property keeps part of the conversion fee. Gradual rollout, email on activation.
items.pitch: Position as 'coming soon', not live yet. Nothing for customers to do now.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. Segmented US/Canada properties + all Adyen terminals in Europe; availability varies by property.

items.title: Compliance Suite coming-soon in-app messages (13 Oct, relaunch 1 Nov)
items.summary: In-app coming-soon messages for Compliance Suite in Belgium, Austria, Poland, Germany, Croatia, Czechia, Sweden, Spain, France, Italy and Norway, plus Tax Automation & Tax Intelligence (USA / Track 1). Launch 13 Oct, relaunch 1 Nov.
items.pitch: Customers in these markets may now see in-app teasers; check country eligibility before promising dates.
items.segmentation: Per-country in-app messages; see Jira tickets TW-2727 to TW-2739.

items.title: Tips report in Mews POS
items.summary: New Tips report shows tips, service charges and tip pool contributions by date range, outlet, employee and transaction; exports to CSV/Excel/PDF. Employees see their own tips in the POS Android app.
items.pitch: Payroll prep without stitching data together; supports North America tipping needs.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. All properties with tipping enabled on at least one outlet.

items.title: Accurate no-show figures in Reservation report
items.summary: Expired Inquired/Optional reservations are now cancelled as 'Confirmation missed' instead of 'No show'. Confirmed guests who don't arrive remain 'No show'.
items.pitch: Data-accuracy fix; nothing to set up. Older reservations keep original reason.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. All Mews Operations users.

items.title: Sell limits for rates
items.summary: Cap how many rooms a rate or rate group sells per day or date range, optionally by room category. Rate stops selling that day once the limit is reached. Limits apply in Mews PMS, Booking Engine and API only, not other channel managers/CRSs yet.
items.pitch: Staff rates are the main example. Don't promise it works on every channel.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. All Mews PMS users.

items.title: Clear price and occupancy overrides in bulk
items.summary: In the Revenue workspace, clear price and/or occupancy overrides across a date range in one action, filtered by day of week, override type and space category.
items.pitch: Time-saver after busy periods or promotions.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. All Revenue workspace users.

items.title: New reservation table view and side panel
items.summary: New reservation table with filtering, sorting and search, plus a side panel to view/edit reservations from Timeline and Reservation Overview without opening the full module. Helps large group blocks.
items.pitch: Edit in context; search and filter a 100-person block.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. All Mews Operations users.

items.title: Duplicate keys instead of cancelling existing ones
items.summary: When issuing a key, choose 'new' (cancels earlier keys, as before) or 'duplicate' (keeps earlier keys active). Works for physical keys and guests with a digital key.
items.pitch: Removes a common front desk annoyance; default behaviour unchanged.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. All Mews Operations users.

items.title: Billing visibility at check-out
items.summary: Check-out dialog now shows bills on the reservations being checked out: which have amounts owed, which close and why others stay open, where closed bills are sent. Address can be fixed in place.
items.pitch: No more guessing which bill blocks check-out. Germany only for now.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. Germany only.

items.title: Bulk price editing: different price per date
items.summary: Bulk price edits can now set a unique custom price or RMS price hierarchy for each date in one edit. Hierarchies require Mews RMS.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. Bulk editing for all users; price hierarchies for Mews RMS customers.

items.title: Germany e-invoicing via Peppol
items.summary: German properties can send compliant e-invoices via Peppol from Mews. E-invoice is created and sent when a bill closes; status shown in Fiscal Record Report. Runs alongside XRechnung.
items.pitch: Ahead of Germany's 2027/2028 B2B e-invoicing mandate; opt-in via Marketplace.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. Germany only. Opt-in via Marketplace, EUR 25 per property per month.

items.title: Italy e-invoicing via SdI
items.summary: Mews generates the FatturaPA invoice and submits it to SdI on bill close; no certificate needed; status in Fiscal Record Report. Covers B2B, B2G, B2C.
items.pitch: SdI confirmation can take up to 24h; don't promise instant confirmation.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. Italian properties.

items.title: Mews Automations
items.summary: Build, run and monitor workflows with triggers, filters and actions; monitoring view shows what ran or was blocked; three templates (room upgrades, amenity gifts, upsell offers).
items.pitch: Lead with the templates; monitoring builds trust.
items.segmentation: Tier 1. All Mews Operations users.

items.title: Mews Guest Messaging
items.summary: One inbox in Mews Operations for SMS, WhatsApp, Booking.com, Expedia and more; AI can draft replies.
items.pitch: Lead with time saved and no missed messages.
items.segmentation: Tier 1. All users.

items.title: Accounts Receivable reminder templates and history
items.summary: Edit 4 reusable invoice reminder templates and review full history of reminders sent per invoice and account.
items.pitch: Consistent follow-ups; nobody chases the same invoice twice.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. Properties eligible for Accounts Receivable.

items.title: Trial Balance for any period
items.summary: Trial Balance is a native report covering weekly, monthly or custom periods, not just daily exports.
items.pitch: Reconcile a whole month in one report.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. US, Canada, Mexico, Panama, BES, Costa Rica, Curaçao, Singapore, Puerto Rico.

items.title: Mews Payments Checkout (GA announced in #rnd)
items.summary: Partners embed Mews Payments in their own booking engines (card, Apple/Google Pay, SEPA, iDEAL). Announced as GA in #rnd; not seen in #prod-roadmap-updates, TW Jira or the changelog in this run. Confirm public status before mentioning.
items.segmentation: Payments Checkout. 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Events rebuild in PMS
items.summary: Hold announcements: too early to demo externally. Working assumptions only, do not hard-commit dates: Alpha late Nov 2026 (design partners, not for sale), Beta H1 Q1 2027, GA soft launch late Q1 2027. Teaser video may be shared 1:1 only (not socials). Legacy Mews Events in maintenance mode.
items.segmentation: Events rebuild. 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Front of House items moving to beta/GA in next 30 days
items.summary: From internal October TOI: Order Item Splitting, Bills in Guest Portal, Invite companion from homepage / to OCI, Kiosk on Payment Terminals, Keep spaces in sync with Mews, Adyen in Mews POS, Italy no blocked registers on fiscalization failure, Booking.com in Guest Messenger without marketplace integration, Match & Merge Workspace, profile duplicate indicators. Dates and scope not public.
items.segmentation: FoH TOI. 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Back of House items (TOI)
items.summary: From internal October TOI: Hostel support, D-EDGE API migration, Agentic Fact Learning, Custom Overrides per date, Remove Bulk Overrides (latter now released, see GA). Not publicly confirmed.
items.segmentation: BoH TOI. 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Fintech look-ahead Oct–Nov
items.summary: From internal TOI: Payouts API and Balance Transactions API (beta), recurring payments with iDEAL, new Payments report, available balance for US business account, KYB for US properties in Airwallex toolkit, S1 end of sale.
items.segmentation: Fintech TOI. 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Time zone database upgrade (TZDB 2026e) on 3 Nov
items.summary: Internal plan to upgrade the time zone database on 3 Nov, following an incident where Moroccan properties couldn't book. Manual test planned 28 Oct. Clock-change days in Azores, Canada, Mexico, Kyrgyzstan covered.
items.segmentation: TZDB upgrade. 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.
